datasets.name: NASA POWER Monthly Regional API (source-native MERRA-2 grid)

methods.fdr_note: Benjamini-Hochberg applied across all eligible grid cells within one testing family: one variable x one domain x one period x one aggregation. Spatial correlation means BH's independence condition is not strictly met; BY is available as a conservative alternative.

test.primary: mann-kendall (normal approximation with tie and continuity correction)
test.ci: Mann-Kendall / Gilbert confidence interval for Sen's slope

grid.note: MERRA-2 native resolution retained worldwide; no resampling.
